g.text: Datapath with pipeline registers, hazard detection and forwarding
A load-use stall and four forwarding paths

text.font-family: 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif

g.text: Without forwarding, each dependent instruction waits in ID for its producer's WB and the

text.font-family: 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif

g.text: last one retires in cycle 14. With forwarding only the load-use pair stalls, for one cycle:

text.font-family: 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Times, 'Liberation Serif', serif

g.text: the run ends in cycle 9 instead of 8. Dashed cells are stages held by the stall.

g.text: FIVE-STAGE PIPELINE; DASHED LINES ARE CONTROL, BLUE LINES CARRY FORWARDED OPERANDS
